name: WSAD Camera Keybind Overhaul
author: Community
description: Replaces the default Engine/defprofile/keydefaults.lua so plain W/A/S/D pan the camera (action bindings that previously claimed those bare letters shift to Shift+letter). Ships three presets: vanilla (restore stock), wasd-camera (replace Classic), wasd-camera-ingame (replace Modern slot for in-game dropdown selection).
